result.title: ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning
result.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training
result.summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ProbePO，一种无 critic 的 LLM 强化学习方法：用无奖励的不确定性分数挑选部分解状态，在受限续写预算下估计其期望验证奖励，再将 GRPO 的轨迹级优势重新分配到各 token 上并保持轨迹均值不变，从而细化信用分配。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预算受限下选择哪些部分解进行评估、再用测量结果细化轨迹级优势」的思路，与 LVR 关心的推理步贡献分配、停止与计算预算决策、潜在状态监督有具体可借鉴线索，可供核查能否迁移到多模态 latent 推理场景。
